cohort: 974 pregnant women diagnosed with MG and a control group of pregnant women without MG, identified from the United States' Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project Nationwide Inpatient Sample from 2005 to 2015
finding: Pregnant women with MG are at a significantly greater risk of experiencing acute respiratory failure and having a preterm birth compared to pregnant women without MG.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the risk of cesarean section or instrumental vaginal delivery between women with and without MG.
